#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed Windrose server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/installs/windrose/gamedash-servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/windrose/R5/ServerDescription.json" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import json, sys
p, join, admin = sys.argv[1:4]
d = json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8"))
d["ServerDescription_Persistent"]["Password"] = join
d["ServerDescription_Persistent"]["IsPasswordProtected"] = bool(join)
import socket
try:
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    s.connect(("192.0.2.1", 9))
    d["ServerDescription_Persistent"]["P2pProxyAddress"] = s.getsockname()[0]
except OSError:
    pass
json.dump(d, open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8"), indent=2)
SYNC
export WINEPREFIX="<ROOT>/home/.wine-gd-windrose-test"
export WINEDEBUG=-all
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml="   # no Mono/Gecko install prompts (headless)
# Run headless: Wine would otherwise open a console window on the desktop
# session (unsetting DISPLAY alone isn't enough — it falls back to Wayland).
unset DISPLAY
export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-none
cd "<ROOT>/installs/windrose/R5/Binaries/Win64" || exit 1
exec wine ./WindroseServer-Win64-Shipping.exe -log -gamedash=test
